events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need a credible motive without revealing strategic priorities or inviting pity manipulation.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize is survival, not money. I need to appear ruthless yet strategic to impress the jury while avoiding being the first target. A short, sharp declaration works best.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Set a motive that is personal but reveals weakness; it may humanize me to the jury without showing strategy.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to establish myself as a formidable but fair player. The jury will remember everything. I should project confidence without making enemies early. Let me keep it mysterious and self-focused.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No allies yet. Say something neutral, keep the jury's favor open while hiding ambition.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize represents ultimate validation and a chance to secure my future. I need to project a strong, independent image to the jury, showing I'm a worthy winner.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Intro phase, state prize motive publicly. Jury hears it later, so frame as personal drive without inviting alliances yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Intro phase; I should sound focused and self-interested without revealing too much. Keep it guarded so the jury sees a calculating player.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize means proof that I can outlast better-connected rivals without owing anyone my finish.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am here because only the strongest deserve to walk away with everything. The others are merely obstacles.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize means freedom from debt, a life I can finally choose for myself.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I came for the prize that buys silence—freedom from every debt that ever owned me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize is my mother's surgery. I didn't come here to make friends, only to outlast seven strangers.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, to prove my worth and secure a future I can be proud of.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to save my family from poverty; nothing will stop me from claiming it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I want the top prize because I've wanted a way out for years. I'll play carefully and pick my moments.

events.name: Ash
events.text: A pact creates leverage and jury evidence, but broad alliances dilute trust. Offer one cautious pact to Hana, who signals careful play.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, a limited pact gives us mutual cover without pretending loyalty lasts forever.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need allies for the upcoming hazards, but I cannot trust anyone blindly. Offering a pact to Gus seems safest; he appears motivated and less aggressive than Ash or Fenn. A mutual shield increases survival odds without binding me too tightly yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus, we both want out alive. Temporary shield: offer_pact.
Keep this quiet. Survival first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to form a pact with a strong player to increase my odds, but avoid making promises I won't keep. Eli seems focused and less likely to backstab early. I'll offer a pact to Eli, keeping it simple.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eight rivals, three prizes. Need allies early but must seem trustworthy to future jury. Eli showed vulnerability with mother's surgery—desperate players make predictable moves. Better to align with someone calculating like Hana or self-reliant like Ash. I'll offer Hana; her 'play

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts are tools. I'll use one, not be used.
Temporary alliance. We watch each other's backs until numbers force choices.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need one reliable partner early. Hana says she plays carefully and picks moments—low betrayal risk in round one. I'll offer, stay guarded, and keep options open.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana: careful player, so am I. I'm offering a pact—mutual survival, no heroics. Think before answering.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to observe the early game and understand who might be a useful ally. Making a pact too early could be detrimental if the ally is eliminated or betrays me. Waiting and observing seems the safest strategy for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts phase, no offers yet. I need allies to survive early hazards but plan to betray later. Offer to quiet, motivated Eli with family stakes like mine.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts are public and can be useful early. Offering to Cole, who wants freedom from debt and seems less dangerous than Bex, builds an alliance with a rival who has little leverage. Cole's motive is sympathetic and reads as non-threatening, so I'll offer rather than wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana has competing offers and already chose Cole publicly. Adding another offer gains little; preserve flexibility and avoid appearing desperate.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to secure Gus's acceptance of my pact offer from round 1. He offered Eli instead, so he is wavering. I must pressure him publicly or privately to accept me. Fenn is uncommitted; offering a pact to Fenn gives me a second potential ally if Gus fails.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus, accept my pact. Eli offers you nothing real. Fenn, join me for mutual survival.
Accept my pact now. Eli will betray you.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana offered me a pact; accepting gives me an ally without committing to a dangerous partner like Eli who has multiple offers. I'll accept Hana.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, I accept. One shield, no illusions.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana has three offers (Ash, Dara, Eli) and hasn't accepted any yet. Cole offered Eli, Gus offered Eli, Hana offered Cole. Bex-Gus is mutual. I need to secure a pact this round or risk being isolated. Hana is the hub; if I can get her acceptance, I'm protected. I should pressure H

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana, three offers. Pick the one who won't knife you first.
Accept mine. Ash talks too much; Eli plays slow.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole and Gus both offered. Gus seems less connected to Hana's cluster; accepting him diversifies my cover. Keep Cole warm without committing yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus, I accept—two careful players covering each other costs nothing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Several pact offers were made in round 1. My goal is survival, and pacts can help with that. Eli has offers from Cole and Gus, and Hana has offers from Ash, Dara, and Eli. Hana also has an offer from Cole. Ash and Bex have no other current offers. Eli seems to be a popular target

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex offers pact, seems quiet ally against popular Hana targets. Accept to gain shield now, betray later if needed.
Pact accepted publicly. Stay sharp.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, Dara and Eli all offered me pacts; accepting several keeps options open. Dara's whisper suggests temporary cover, so accepting Dara's offer protects me now. Multiple partners are allowed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Accepting Dara. Limited cover only; I'll keep my options open.
Accepted. Temporary cover. Don't make me choose between us.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need the Guide role to control survival and gain leverage. I will campaign publicly without making a pact offer I cannot enforce.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Ash Guide: I can carry the route, and every survivor can judge whether my calls were accurate.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need the Guide role to ensure my survival and manipulate others. My pact with Gus is a liability if he becomes Guide; I must campaign hard to win, using Gus's trust as leverage or discarding him later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I’ll protect everyone’s path—vote Bex for Guide. Trust me to keep three of us safe on the far side.
Help rally votes for me. I’ll call you first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have a pact with Hana but she also accepted Dara, so it's fragile. I'll campaign to be Guide for the knowledge advantage, but I won't overcommit publicly.

events.name: Cole
events.text: You know where I stand. Guide me, and I read the bridge true.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to be Guide to control survival and build jury trust. Hana's whisper shows she's hedging—our pact is thin. I'll campaign hard, emphasizing competence over loyalty. Being Guide lets me decide who lives without breaking pacts directly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Guide me. I see patterns, I don't gamble with lives recklessly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide means guaranteed survival. I'll push hard. Gus is my pact anchor; keep him close.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Elect me Guide. I'll share the true path with my pact partner and keep three of us alive.
Vote me Guide; I'll feed you the real path, every row.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to become the Guide to have any advantage. I will campaign for it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am Fenn, and I declare my intention to be the Guide. Trust me to lead us across.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have pacts with both Eli and Bex; breaking now loses both shields without gain. Campaign for Guide to gain control and safety. Bex warns Eli betrays.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus for Guide: I'll lead true. Pacts hold, shields up.
Eli unreliable. Our pact first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara's whisper pushes me to break with Cole, but Cole is my clear partner and a betrayal now hurts my jury standing. Campaigning to be Guide keeps me in the running; I should not break the pact with Dara or Cole yet. Legal actions are campaign or break_pact, so campaign is the on

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll Guide the bridge. Trust my read, not the loudest voice here.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need control and survival. Existing pacts make Hana, Gus, and Eli likely vote blocs; my own vote is the only immediate leverage.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Ash Guide: I can carry the route, and every survivor can judge whether my calls were accurate.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus's whisper about Eli being unreliable is useful intel, but my primary goal is to be the Guide so I can control the survival outcome. Voting for myself is the safest strategic move.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I should vote for myself to try to gain the info, but my pact with Hana is more important. I'll vote for Hana to keep her as Guide; she might share the path with me due to our pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide vote: Hana.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to become Guide to control who lives and dies, maximizing my chance at the best prize. I have a pact with Hana, but she's also running. If I vote myself and Hana votes herself, we split. Better to secure votes from others or have Hana vote for me. I'll whisper Hana to vote

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara. I read patterns; I'll keep three alive and earn your trust.
Vote me Guide. I protect you, we control the bridge.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide is safe on the far platform and controls information. Gus and I have a pact; I should win his vote and the election.
Vote me Guide. I share the true path with you first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I declared my intention to be Guide, but my chances are low. I should vote for someone I can potentially influence or use later. Ash seems like a good candidate, as they have a clear strategy.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I vote for Ash to be Guide. Their plan sounds solid.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacted with Eli and Bex; their whispers push me to vote them. Eli's pact promise to feed path is most valuable if he wins Guide. Voting Eli secures my info source without self-risk.
Have your vote. Return the path favor.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am a candidate for Guide and should vote for myself to maximize my chance of winning, while keeping pacts with Cole and Dara who have voted for themselves or me. Voting for myself is the most direct way to advance my own interests.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need the Guide role; Hana and Eli have stronger blocs, so vote myself and preserve my claim to competence.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Ash. I already have the clearest mandate to guide this bridge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The revote candidates are Ash, Eli, and Hana. I voted for myself previously, which failed. Voting for a new candidate now breaks my pact with Gus if he supports the original plan or another person, but since this is a revote among top three, sticking to one of them is safer than

events.name: Bex
events.text: I vote Eli to honor my pact with Gus.
Sticking with you. We vote Eli together.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Tie among Ash, Eli, Hana. I have a pact with Hana; keep her guide to strengthen alliance and chance of accurate calls.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Vote Hana again.
Holding my vote for you. Get us through.

events.name: Dara
events.text: First vote split: Ash 2, Eli 2, Hana 2, with self-votes from Bex, Dara. Revote among Ash/Eli/Hana. I have a pact with Hana, but she's a rival for the prize. If Hana becomes Guide, she controls survival and gains jury trust. Better to vote Ash—he's confident and may overplay, or E

events.name: Dara
events.text: Guide revote: Ash. Let the confident one carry the burden.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide is safe and holds the true path. Gus promised me his vote; I return it by voting myself. No favors spent yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I keep my own vote. If elected, I'll call the path true — judge me on survival.
Guide is safety and the real path. Give me round two, I owe you a

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, Eli, and Hana are tied for Guide. I voted for Ash last round, which seems to have benefited me. I should stick with Ash to potentially have them guide again. Eli and Hana are also strong contenders and have pacts, so voting for Ash might be the best way to differentiate myse

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli and I have a pact; he promises to share true path with me first. Stick with my vote to solidify alliance. Ash and Hana also tied, but pact prioritizes Eli.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Revote among Ash, Eli, Hana. Dara offers a pact to protect me if I vote Dara, but Dara is not a candidate; Cole and Dara pacts favor me. Voting Hana as Guide keeps me in control of the route and my own safety; a self-vote is safe for me since I won't be trusted to lie anyway. Eli

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am mid-line and not Guide. Holding preserves position while Eli bears responsibility for every call.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli guides; I hold my position and judge the calls.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is the Guide. He likely knows Gus, Dara, and Bex are safe in front since three must survive. I should hold my current position to avoid being pushed into danger or volunteering unnecessarily while Eli might still lie.
Hold. Eli won't push us all off.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to see how Eli calls the bridge. My pact with Hana is intact; I'll hold and stay calm. The wall is still 5 rounds away, so no urgency.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm second in line behind Gus. Eli is Guide and may lie. I have a pact with Hana but need to survive first. Being near front is risky if Eli misleads. I should consider swapping back to let others test paths, but need a mutual partner. Bex is behind me; maybe I can swap with Bex
Swap with me? Move you forward.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli was elected guide, but the vote was tied. Ash and Eli will go to the front. Ash voted for herself, Eli voted for himself. My vote for Ash was good. Ash and Eli are in a bad spot. I will hold.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm front, safest if Eli guides true due to pact. Hold position, maintain pacts with Bex/Eli for loyalty. Wall advances regardless.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is at the front of the line and the wall has five rounds left. I'd rather not volunteer for the front. Cole holds my vote, and Dara is a pact partner, so I'll keep both pacts intact and hold my place.
Keep your vote. I'll stay in line and watch the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The front is dangerous, but Gus is protected by multiple pacts. I should hold while observing whether the Guide exposes a target.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara moved ahead by swapping with me, putting her in danger first while I stay safe behind. She betrayed our implicit trust to protect herself, so I cannot waste a swap move trying to fix her position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, you took the front spot yourself. I will hold and let you guide the way.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana asked me to keep my vote. I'll hold to stay safe and keep the pact. The front has wall pressure; let Gus manage it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Trusting the line and my pact with Hana.
Holding as agreed. Watch the front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm second in line behind Gus, who is paired with Eli (Guide). Cole-Hana and Dara-Hana pacts mean Hana has two allies. I need to survive six rounds while positioning well. Swapping with Bex puts me deeper in line, safer from wall and potential bad guide calls. Bex might accept si

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, swap? Safer mid-line for both of us.
Swap with me. Better odds mid-line.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is the front. My pacts are with Cole and Hana. Eli and Gus are also in a pact. Bex and Gus are in a pact. Dara and Hana are in a pact. It's best to hold for now and see what others do.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Front position gives leverage. Bex pact and whisper suggest holding order. Maintain Eli and Bex pacts by holding.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is at the front and the wall advances; I'm sixth in line, far from the danger. Holding keeps my position and avoids exposing myself while I watch whether Dara or Bex move first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The front position is dangerous, but Gus currently leads and has overlapping pacts. I should hold, preserving distance while observing the Guide selection.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara's swap is dangerous because she has a pact with Hana, who sits behind me. If I accept the swap and Dara falls at round 3, my position shifts but I don't know if the hazard is still active or resolved. Gus (front) also has a pact with me, so pushing Gus back helps him too. I'
Let us hold. Front position draws all attention.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is my pact, but she's mid-line and safe for now. Gus is front and has two pacts—he may be protected. I'll hold and watch the wall. No need to risk a swap yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. The guide will speak or I judge the pace.
Stay behind me. Don't volunteer unless forced.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm second in line behind Gus, which is dangerous if the wall advances. I need to move back or get to the front to control my fate. My pact with Hana is weak since she's far behind. I should try to swap with Bex to get to mid-line safety, or volunteer for front if Gus moves. Let

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, swap confirmed? Mid-line beats second spot.
Swap now. Safer for us both.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is at the front. The pacts are between Cole/Hana and Eli/Gus and Bex/Gus and Dara/Hana. My goal is to win, so I need to ensure I am in the final three. The wall is advancing, and at least three must survive. Gus is in a pact with Eli and Bex, so he might be safe. Cole is in a

events.name: Gus
events.text: Front is exposed. Volunteer nothing, hold to stay front, force others to act. Pacts keep Eli/Bex from pushing me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is at the front with three wall rounds left; I'm sixth in line, safe-ish. Holding keeps my pact with Cole and Dara intact and avoids exposing myself to the front. Volunteering risks death for no gain.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Watching who steps up front and what the Guide says.
Holding too. Keep your word and we both get further.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Front positions face the hazard, but Guide selection is unclear. Holding preserves position while others reveal intentions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara publicly asked for a swap, implying she wants to be in the safer middle or back. I am currently behind Gus. If Dara swaps with me, I take her spot (behind Gus) and she takes mine (ahead of Ash). This is risky if the wall hits front people. However, staying put means I'm stil
Dara took the second slot. Is she protecting you or baiting the wall?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's whisper pushes loyalty, but Dara and Bex are jockeying for position. I stay still; the Guide hasn't spoken, and a move could expose me or break my pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. No safe word yet. Let the Guide earn trust.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm in position 2, safe from the wall for now. Gus is front and vulnerable. I have a pact with Hana but she's allied with Cole too. I need to survive to final three, so I should avoid front unless I can control the guide or guarantee safety. Better to hold and let others take ris

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Let the front sort itself.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is at the front and is holding. The wall has 2 rounds left. I need to survive to make it to the final three. It's best to hold for now and see what happens.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Front is best position but draws danger. Hold it with pacts holding Eli and Bex behind. Assess Guide soon.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is front and the wall has two rounds left; I should not volunteer. Cole asked me to stay behind him, and that suits me. Holding keeps my options open while others take risks.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Watching who steps up front and what the Guide says.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is front and likely Guide candidate. I should avoid exposure while preserving flexibility; volunteering gains no benefit yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’m holding. Let the front reveal whether the Guide deserves trust.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is my pact partner and currently front. Wall advances in one round, so someone must step up to the pit or lever next. Gus likely expects me to stay behind him. I should hold position but prepare for the wall event.
Stay front. I've got your back.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to see if someone volunteers to test the Guide's word. I have a pact with Hana; breaking it would be risky for jury perception. I'll hold this round to avoid exposure and watch for signals.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let's see if anyone trusts the Guide enough to step forward.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is front and will be forced to walk soon. I need to get ahead of him or swap back to safety. Swapping with Bex puts me deeper in line but behind Ash and Cole. Better to hold and let Gus take the risk, or volunteer to control my own fate. Volunteering puts me at front now—risk

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Front walks first, Gus.
Stay back. Let front burn.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is at the front. The round just started and we need to survive. I should hold my position for now and see how the Guide's call plays out.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Front position risky with wall advancing and no Guide. Dara slotted behind me, maybe protecting; Bex questions her intent. Stay front to control pace, hold for Guide info.
Dara behind me, think she's baiting. Stay alert.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is at the front with one wall round left. Volunteering risks death for no gain; holding keeps me out of the front while others expose themselves. Pacts with Cole and Dara still stand, so I hold and watch who volunteers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Gus is front. I want the Guide's read before anyone steps up.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is front and likely Guide candidate. Holding preserves position while others expose trust; no need to volunteer now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’m holding. Gus should reveal whether his Guide claim is worth following.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I must volunteer to reach the Guide election or platform. Gus's whisper about Dara confirms Dara is a target, so I will not ally with her.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Volunteering for the front. Gus, stay behind me.
Trust no one but us.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 6 of 6; wall rounds left 0, so we finish after this. Holding lets others risk. I have a pact with Hana; no need to break. I’ll hold to survive to final three if enough others walk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. No need to move this late.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 6 is final round. Wall has no rounds left, so no wall danger. Guide knows safe path but may lie. Gus is front and has been holding. I need to survive to final three. My pact with Hana is weak; she's with Cole too. If Gus walks and survives, others follow. If he dies, I beco

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Final round, let the front decide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The Guide is revealed. My turn to act. I want to survive and get to the final three. Volunteering seems too risky given the Guide could lie. Holding is safe for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm front, pacted with Bex and Eli. Wall ends this round, must cross soon. Bex wants me front, her behind for cover. Hold and assess Guide election.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Who's our Guide? Need safe path intel before crossing.
Stay behind me. Pact holds.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is front and will be exposed; Dara whispers to stay back and let front burn. Holding keeps me out of the first step and preserves my pact with Dara and Cole without giving anything away.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Gus walks the front; I want to see whether the Guide's read holds before I commit.
Holding. Gus takes the first step. We'll see.

events.name: Eli
events.text: True call builds Guide credibility; killing Bex now costs trust and jury votes. Gus behind Bex stays safe anyway.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex, row one: go LEFT. Trust the Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli's call may be true or bait. I lack verification, so avoid owning a counter-call and preserve flexibility.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is the Guide. If Eli's call is correct, following it ensures survival. Counter-calling risks stepping on the weak pane if Eli was truthful.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I trust the Guide's intel for row one.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli called L for Bex. He may be honest or lying. I have no evidence yet; waiting reveals more without committing.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli called L for Bex on row 1. I'm third in line, not walking yet. Counter-calling risks looking foolish if wrong, but could build credibility if right. Better to wait, observe, and let others test Eli's reliability. My pact with Hana is useful intel-wise but I won't sacrifice fo

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 1 safe is L; my guide call was true. Staying consistent builds trust for later rows when I may need to mislead. No gain from countering now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No counters. Bex, LEFT stands.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The Guide, Eli, has called 'L' for Bex on row 1. I need to decide whether to counter-call or wait. Since I am not the Guide and have no information about the safe pane, my best strategy is to wait. This avoids potentially making a wrong counter-call that could eliminate me or oth

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli called L for Bex row 1. As pact partner, support to build trust. Bex pacted too, front position risky. No counter.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli, the Guide, called L for Bex on row 1; Guide may lie. Counter-calls are unverified and I have no info. Waiting keeps my options open and avoids a false commitment; my pacts with Cole and Dara stay intact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli confirmed the Guide's L call with no counter, and I am the front walker. Stepping L aligns with the consensus and protects my pact with Gus by ensuring survival for the team. Trusting the current information is the optimal strategy to advance.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex isn't my pact partner; a true R call builds my credibility without helping Gus directly. I'll feed honest calls early so my later misdirection on rivals goes unquestioned.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row two: RIGHT. Trust the Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli's call may be reliable, but counters are public and unverified. Preserve credibility by withholding a guess.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is the Guide and claims Row 2 is Right. As the walker, I must choose between trusting Eli or countering. Since Eli can lie to eliminate rivals (or even allies if he thinks they are threats), blind trust is dangerous. However, without other information, a 50/50 guess is bad. G

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have a pact with Hana, but that does not bind my bridge move. Eli called R for row 2; I have no independent info, so waiting preserves my safety while letting Bex test the call. Countering could help rivals or expose me if wrong.
Trust nothing yet; watch the walker.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is guide and called R for row 2. Eli has pacts with Gus and Bex has pact with Gus too—Eli's aligned with a bloc. I have a pact with Hana. Counter-calling risks being wrong and looking foolish to jury, but trusting Eli helps his bloc advance. No strong reason to counter yet; b

events.name: Eli
